code:
Source DB (Oracle, MySQL, ...)
  --> Extract        (reads the source's own logs)
  --> Trail file      (platform-neutral change records)
  --> Data Pump        (ships trail files across network)
  --> Replicat        (applies changes to target,
                        can transform along the way)
caption: GoldenGate's Data Pump ≠ Oracle's expdp/impdp Data Pump — same name only.

code:
1. Zero-downtime migration
   old platform -> GoldenGate -> new platform
   (minutes of cutover, not a long outage)

2. Real-time integration
   operational DB -> GoldenGate -> data warehouse
   (no batch ETL window)

3. Active-active, multi-region writes
caption: Data Guard protects one Oracle database. GoldenGate moves data between databases.
